  let Reg := fun f : Path => ∀ n : ℕ, ∃ u : ℝ → lp (fun _ : ℤ=>ℂ) 2,  ContDiff ℝ ((⊤:ℕ∞):WithTop ℕ∞) u ∧ ∀ t k, FromLP 1 (u t) k=(k:ℂ)^n*f t k
  have basic:=@yui_aux_0064 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013
  have hc : ∀ m : ℕ, ∀ f, Reg f → ∀ a b : ℝ, ContH (m:ℝ) a b f:=by
    intro m
    induction m with
    | zero =>
      intro f hf a b
      obtain ⟨u,hu,he⟩:=hf 0
      have hue : ∀ t, FromLP 1 (u t)=f t:=by intro t; funext k; simpa using he t k
      have hh:=(@yui_aux_0057 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 f).mp ⟨u,hu.continuous,hue⟩
      refine ⟨fun t ht=>(h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 1 _ (by norm_num) (hh.1 t)).1,?_⟩
      intro t ht ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩:=hh.2 t ε hε
      refine ⟨δ,hδ,?_⟩
      intro r hr hdr
      have hm:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 1).2.2.1 _ _ (hh.1 r) (hh.1 t)
      exact lt_of_le_of_lt (h_T013.2.2.2.1 0 1 _ (by norm_num) hm.1).2 (hd r hdr)
    | succ m ih =>
      intro f hf a b
      have hfc:=ih f hf a b
      have hdc:=ih _ (basic.2.2.2.1 f hf) a b
      refine ⟨fun t ht=>basic.2.2.2.2 f hf t (m+1),?_⟩
      intro t ht ε hε
      obtain ⟨δ,hδ,hd⟩:=hfc.2 t ht (ε/2) (by linarith)
      obtain ⟨η,hη,he⟩:=hdc.2 t ht (ε/2) (by linarith)
      refine ⟨min δ η,lt_min hδ hη,?_⟩
      intro r hr hdr
      have h1:=hd r hr (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_left _ _))
      have h2:=he r hr (lt_of_lt_of_le hdr (min_le_right _ _))
      have hm:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).2.2.1 _ _ (hfc.1 r hr) (hfc.1 t ht)
      have hdm:=(@yui_aux_0003 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 (m:ℝ)).2.2.1 _ _ (hdc.1 r hr) (hdc.1 t ht)
      have eqn : (fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*(f r-f t) k)=(fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f r k)-(fun k : ℤ=>(k:ℂ)*f t k):=by funext k; exact mul_sub _ _ _
      have hb:=(@yui_aux_0072 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 m _ hm.1 (eqn ▸ hdm.1)).2
      rw [eqn] at hb
      simp only [Nat.cast_add,Nat.cast_one]
      linarith
  refine ⟨fun f hf m=>hc m f hf,?_⟩
  intro f hf a b hab
  have hcoord:=(@yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).1 f hf
  refine ⟨fun k=>(hcoord k).contDiffOn,?_⟩
  intro m j
  have hh:=hc m _ ((@yui_aux_0066 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013).2 f hf j) a b
  apply @yui_aux_0073 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 _ _ _ _ _ hh
  intro t ht
  funext k
  exact iteratedDerivWithin_eq_iteratedDeriv (uniqueDiffOn_Icc hab)
    ((hcoord k).of_le (le_of_lt (@yui_aux_0052 T gamma R h_E006 h_T005 h_T013 j))).contDiffAt ht)
